verdict.rationale: Brex documents top-line budget assignment with instant spend tracking (brex-docs-10) and a Budgets API for managing Budgets and Spend Limits (brex-docs-5). It also describes auto-enforced limits (brex-docs-9), automatic blocking of out-of-policy purchases (brex-docs-36), and rule-based approval routing (brex-docs-8, brex-docs-11, brex-docs-16), which together cover the core of allocating budgets and having limits and approvals enforce them. Most of this is marketing copy rather than in-depth docs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of allocating budgets per team/project (as opposed to top-line), detail on how budget limits bind to card limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of enforcement.
